items.title: 68191_William (Bill) H. Challis Oral History Interview
items.q: I joined them. I played with the band... I worked with him for several months

ctx.x: Not a prom, but a fraternity dance$. House parties, and then we'd go around and hear the various bands. And also these bands would come to Bucknell and play the houseparties, and we'd get a chance to go around and hear them. I sat in with a few there. I sat in with the Warings. I Sat in with Dave Harman and which were all traveling bands.
Now, let's see. Well, the Waring band of course and he wanted me to play with that band and I told him that I couldn't leave school. So we had one time, we had Dave Harman
